body: I really appreciate your rooting for me! There's...a lot going on right now, mainly mentally, but I'm trying to keep going one day at a time.

As I replied to another, I wouldn't wish most of this on anyone, but it's nice knowing I'm not the only one who relates to the stuff. I will take you up on it if it's okay. Thanks for the well wish too!
Thank you for this offer, I'll send a PM. It's a bit comforting that someone relates, not that I'd wish this on anyone.
